test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A paper is folded and cut as shown. How will it appear when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ab3dd19859644b0cdd247882e04326d62dda7252925c4b7fbda1fcc9ab032b0.png]
solution:
Here, we have a paper and the paper is folded three times to make a small square.

In that, they have cut the small square paper as in the image given in the figure 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e19640a90e0210f656c205d5671bb9301a0ab41e4a58be493161f9c6cf0ffd4.png] 

And then when we open one fold of the paper we get the same image but the position of the circle and the triangle is changed.

Next we will open the last fold of the paper and we will get the opposite image in the next half of the paper, as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/001cb51aa8aea7aa7a14d3ba41a55a8f39501dfccdca92306cfccf2eef3c8a53.png] 

Hence, we will get this as the final answer, i.e.** option 2.**
